poc_summary: Trial period: 14 days on Hosted API. Observed traffic during trial: baseline 3-5 QPS, peak bursts up to 18 QPS during product release notifications. Average request mix: 75% short chat prompts (~30-80 tokens input, ~40-100 tokens output), 15% medium completions (200-800 tokens), 10% embeddings/rerank. Client tests included a support-assistant flow (context windows ~2-3k tokens), and reranking for product recommendations. Latency targets: 95th < 350ms for small prompts, P50 < 120ms; business requirement: 99th < 800ms for peak. Cost sensitivity: mid (wants predictable unit cost; open to reserved commit for 20-40% discount). Model preference: prefer a 13B- or 30B-class open model quantized variant for balance of throughput vs quality; willing to accept quantized fp16/8-bit. Observed issues: periodic 99th spikes during concurrent bursts; client wants KV/prefix caching and batching recommendations.
